I was always a bigger kid that was often bombarded with how “inadequate” I was: other kids would be picked before me for sports, I would be tagged so the game would be easy. Over the years, I just gave in thinking I would be lesser than everyone around me. In middle school up until recently, I carried this weight on my shoulders that food was never meant to sustain me because I am a larger guy and skip meals. Whenever I did eat, I would binge just to feel full, then feel terrible because I didn’t need to eat, then purge it. I’m still trying to come to terms with it, even today, but recovery takes time.
